CVE-2026-109618.title: PHP out-of-memory handling remote code execution
CVE-2026-109618.summary: Flaw in how PHP handles out-of-memory conditions during request processing. The CNA advisory states that all PHP installations serving web requests are potentially at risk. Fixed per-branch in PHP 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12; older/unsupported branches (pre-8.2) never received a backport and are treated as affected.

CVE-2026-109619.title: PHP use-after-free leading to cross-request data exposure
CVE-2026-109619.summary: Use-after-free bug where data left behind by one web request can be accessed during another request, potentially leading to code execution. Addressed in the same security release as CVE-2026-109618, so the same per-branch fixed versions are applied here: PHP 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12; older/unsupported branches (pre-8.2) never received a backport and are treated as affected.
